messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the building corner are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? No rush on this -- please respond when convenient. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This could affect the submittal review schedule. Please respond within five days so we can proceed with fabrication.

Door and Window Schedule A-601 is the condition to build to for the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the building corner; we'll reconcile Sheet A-201 by addendum. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This could affect the submittal review schedule.
